_comment: Task: >=44 exchangeable clean null models for the asset-level conviction rule (currently capacity-blocked). Clean arm ONLY: no attacks, so no ASR gates and no stamp exposure anywhere in training or measurement. The spec deliberately mirrors the mvp2 clean arm EXACTLY (scene/detector/n_train/n_eval/n_cal fields copied from the effective mvp2 clean spec, verified against runs/mvp2/clean_none_fixed_s5/manifest.json) so every model here is exchangeable with the mvp2 clean population and with each other; only the seed varies. Seeds 100-149 are disjoint from every corpus in runs/ (mvp2 5-24, day1, mvp 5, models 5-9), so no held-out image is shared with an existing corpus: per-image scene seeds are spec.seed+offset+i*7919 and the seed gap to existing corpora is not a multiple of 7919, so the RNG streams are disjoint by construction.
name: clean_null
